text: Surgery is a clinical discipline in the field of medicine that mainly uses surgical procedures and other invasive operations (such as interventional therapy, minimally invasive techniques, etc.) to study the occurrence and development patterns of diseases, as well as their diagnosis, treatment and prevention. It is listed as one of the two pillars of clinical medicine along with internal medicine. It addresses structural abnormalities or functional disorders of the human body through physical intervention (such as resection, repair, and reconstruction), involving the diagnosis and treatment of diseases in all systems and organs of the body.
